faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AMC Medical Education Trust Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the AMC Medical Education Trust Recruitment 2026 is 17th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Dean / Cardiologist posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the Dean / Cardiologist posts in the AMC Medical Education Trust Recruitment 2026. This includes one post for Dean and two posts for Full-time Cardiologist.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the AMC Medical Education Trust Recruitment 2026 is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website and submit it via post or as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the Dean post?
faq.answer: For the Dean post, candidates must possess a BDS Degree from an Indian University or an equivalent qualification with a Post Graduate Qualification/Diplomate of National Board in the subject. Additionally, at least 5 years of experience as a Professor in a Dental Institution is required.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for the Cardiologist post?
faq.answer: The required qualification for the Full-time Cardiologist post is DM/DNB/Dr.NB in Cardiology Department. Candidates must also have at least 2 years of experience in the field.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Dean post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Dean post is based on the 6th Pay Commission as Rs. 37,400-67,000 with a Grade Pay of Rs.10,000/-. Under the 7th Pay scale, it is Rs. 1,44,200-2,18,200/- plus allowances.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for the Full-time Cardiologist post?
faq.answer: The Full-time Cardiologist post is contractual for 11 months, with a fixed pay of Rs. 4,00,000/- per month, which is negotiable. This is a significant opportunity for experienced cardiologists.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the AMC Medical Education Trust Recruitment 2026 will be based on a Merit List followed by Document Verification. Candidates are advised to ensure all their documents are in order.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and the application form can be downloaded from the official website of AMC Medical Education Trust, which is https://amcmet.org. The links are also provided in the "Important Links" section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the application fee for the recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for all categories, including General/OBC and SC/ST, is Rs. 1000/-. Candidates are required to pay this fee as part of the application process.
